method: Whole-file manual reading of Slovenian catalog; pinned bytes reverified; v91 structural comparison retained.
findings: Verjetni dvojniki and Vzorčna zgoščena vrednost preserve probability/sampling distinction. Advanced option says sparse hashing above64MiB; this is sampled content, not qualification of sparse-file equality.
Hash prefix and compute-hash labels use zgoščenka, which can denote a compact disc rather than a digest; sampled hash uses explicit zgoščena vrednost. This inconsistency can obscure meaning.

Recovery completion requests checking file data; candidate labels retain recovery/possible recovery distinctions; metadata changes request rescan and same-source-volume restore warns of overwrite. No actual restoration tested.
Junction label retains technical English in parentheses; hardlinks/symbolic links remain separate. Sparse action is separate from compression and logical/physical size labels are explicit.

Whole-phrase search is rendered whole sentence, possibly narrower to a reader than arbitrary phrase. Suspend Prekini can suggest interrupt/terminate; Stop has a separate label Ustavi. These are text-level concerns.

Cloud warning describes potential downloads and refers to settings; permanent-delete wording does not prove secure erasure. Cleanup tokens and permission list ordering retained; MSI sl-SI/1060/1250 remains declaration-only.
limits: No native-speaker certification, rendered Slovenian UI, mnemonic conflict, installer or Windows runtime qualification. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash investigation deferred; completed repository count remains147/500.
